scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:booking && npm run test:www-redirect && npm run test:teacher-calendar
scripts.check:release: npm run check:booking && npm run build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check:fast && npm run check:release && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=portuguese-with-ines --branch=main
scripts.worker:schema: wrangler d1 execute ines-booking --remote --config workers/booking/wrangler.jsonc --file workers/booking/schema.sql
scripts.worker:seed: wrangler d1 execute ines-booking --remote --config workers/booking/wrangler.jsonc --file workers/booking/seed.sql
scripts.test:booking: node workers/booking/test.mjs && node workers/booking/integration-test.mjs && node workers/booking/google-calendar-test.mjs && node workers/booking/meeting-service-test.mjs
